page.title: Action centre
page.description: See every operational signal that needs attention and jump straight to the fix.

unmatchedChannelSkus.label: Unmatched channel SKUs
unmatchedChannelSkus.hint: Channel products cannot flow into planning until they map to an item.

productsMissingBom.label: Products missing BOM
productsMissingBom.hint: Sold finished products need an active material recipe.

materialsMissingSettings.label: Materials missing settings
materialsMissingSettings.hint: Purchased materials need planning defaults before calculation.

dispatchMissingPackaging.label: Dispatch SKUs missing packaging

draftPlansNotFinalized.label: Draft plans not finalized
draftPlansNotFinalized.hint: Saved procurement plans are waiting for review and finalization.

itemsBelowMinimumStock.label: Items below minimum stock
itemsBelowMinimumStock.hint: Inventory alerts indicate stock at or below its configured minimum.
